finding: B1 duplicate reviewed Push
evidence: pushReviewedPlan only checks render-time busy; two same-turn clicks enter the same confirmed request. Server prepares initial links before awaiting auth/provider, so duplicate remote creation is possible. Group G1: synchronous submit guard and delayed-request test requested.

finding: B2 Sync overlaps reviewed operations
evidence: busy excludes syncWorkItems.isPending while the Sync button uses busy; normal pending Sync therefore leaves Sync/Plan/Push callable. G2: include that existing pending state and exercise overlap.

finding: B3 success clears unrelated newly selected IDs
evidence: Bulk onSuccess unconditionally clears the Set; Card checkboxes are outside disabled bulk fieldset. G3: remove only submitted IDs and test delayed completion.

finding: B4 bulk success loses keyboard focus
evidence: Clearing the last selected IDs unmounts the Apply/Archive button; no recovery exists. G4: recover only if the submitted focused control disappears; test user-moved focus preservation.

finding: B5 Windows timing output path
evidence: Timing test writes directly to /tmp, which need not exist on Windows. G5: node:os tmpdir plus path join; no new configuration.

finding: B6 selected Sync State is inert
evidence: Explicit mode omits healthLinks output but retains the selector that only filters it. G6: omit that control in explicit mode.

finding: B7 stale bulk conflict display
evidence: Mutation error survives clear-selection and appears when an unrelated selection remounts the region. G7: clear or scope errors to submitted target set with a regression.

finding: B8 toolbar-to-panel integration gap
evidence: Confirmed null panel mock in board-filter-selection; standalone panel tests supply IDs directly. G8: real toolbar/panel integration over selected visible/hidden/Note and unselected Story.

finding: B9 interim follow-up metadata
evidence: Spec is in-review; false/empty are template defaults before Finalize, not a completed result. Finalize will record the native limit. Workflow explicitly rejects findings whose fix is to edit this spec.

finding: B10 selected dialog changes map defaults
evidence: Use as default remains active in explicit mode and calls updateStoryMap, an unrelated persistent effect from selected Dry Run. G6: conditionally omit in explicit mode, retain full-panel behavior.

finding: E1 same-turn Push dispatch
evidence: Same demonstrated root as B1; busy is render-time only and pushReviewedPlan has no synchronous guard. G1.

finding: V1 actual handoff not protected
evidence: Pre-verified gap: removing selectedCardIds from Toolbar still passes null-panel and standalone tests, widening real flow to whole-map mode. G8 integration regression requested.

finding: V2 unavailable captured Delete target not tested
evidence: Pre-verified gap: no test refreshes an open same-map dialog to make captured target ineligible. G9: archive/remove snapshot target, assert alert/disabled/no request.

finding: I1 board tests span different surfaces
evidence: Descriptive difference, not a demonstrated defect: lifecycle tests mount actual Discovery and Delete; native observed two hidden selected Cards and full confirmation. Direct-hook tests supplement those executed surfaces.

finding: I2 diagnostic fixture excludes board rendering
evidence: Existing timing capture explicitly mounts only toolbar/hook, omitting rendered Card updates in the stated 1000-Card diagnostic. G10: add actual Discovery+Toolbar DOM capture; preserve old raw samples and no native paint or timing pass claim.

finding: I3 final native accessibility/layout limit
evidence: Final native pressKey and getApp both returned cgWindowNotFound. DOM/string/CSS/focus tests pass; actual final-build native layout/focus, zoom/forced colors/screen reader would settle remaining presentation risk. If true medium; unverified.

finding: I4 native planned GitHub write not exercised
evidence: Native run used GitHubOff; mocked API tests exercise reviewed scope without live remote writes. A controlled native planned-flow check with isolated provider would settle UI/provider interaction; no live-write pass claimed. Same unavailable-native evidence group as I3, medium if true.

finding: I5 complementary atomicity surfaces
evidence: No incorrect atomicity claim: actual TCP all-stale/overlap/persistence and server injected-failure history/Activity/live assertions establish backend effects; DOM verifies construction/errors. No full successful browser-to-DB transaction was claimed.

finding: I6 evidence cannot establish every workflow duty
evidence: Descriptive epistemic limit during in-review execution, no violated concrete duty identified. Workflow invocation/render/delegation/verification are observed tool actions; status rows were neither touched nor used as proof.

finding: P1 selected-flow hint describes absent picker
evidence: Parent source verification: explicit mode still says tick Cards above and leave empty for all, although picker omitted and explicit-empty cannot widen. G6: accurate selected-mode copy, full-panel copy preserved.
